primary_target.description: The current Work project chat used by the primary developer and by monitor recovery reports.
primary_target.delivery_requirement: Post factual progress or recovery reports in this Work project after durable state is persisted. A progress report never releases the primary lease or ends the development loop.

truthfulness_rule: This Work project may display prior messages, but those messages are not durable work state or evidence. A report counts as delivered only when posted here after persistence. Reporting, persistence, and delivery are not completion conditions.
